subject: Shadow-admin sampling plan and SCIM delta extract request — HeliumHealth SIG
messages:
From: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@heliumhealth.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: audit-team@heliumhealth.com
Date: 2028-07-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SIG request — sampling for privileged accounts and SCIM delta

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call earlier. As part of our SIG review we need: a) a sampling of privileged accounts (admins/owner roles) across three tenants, and b) a SCIM delta extract that shows role changes for the last 90 days (include timestamps and actor). The auditors prefer CSV samples and a short description of the sampling logic.

Can you confirm what you can deliver and an ETA? Ideally we need the artifacts by EOD Thursday (2028-07-26) to stay on our review timeline. If you have a recommended sampling approach, include it — we want to make sure the sample is representative of both production and sandbox tenants.

Thanks,
Alicia Ramos
Security Manager, HeliumHealth

[HeliumHealth: sig-request-20280722]

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@heliumhealth.com>
Cc: naomi_feldman@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2028-07-22T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG request — sampling for privileged accounts and SCIM delta

Hi Alicia — appreciate the clarity. We can deliver a scoped bundle with: 1) a 50-account privileged sample (across prod/sandbox/partner tenants) exported to XLSX with role labels and last activity, and 2) a SCIM delta CSV for the last 90 days including actor_id, timestamp, attribute_changed (role), and source (API/console).

Proposed sampling approach:
- Stratified sample: 25 production, 15 sandbox, 10 partner/test tenants
- Include accounts with recent admin elevation (last 30 days) to capture JIT patterns
- Redact user PII (email hashes) in the delivered spreadsheet; include mapping keys on request via secure Drive link

ETA: Preliminary extracts by Thursday EOD (2028-07-26). I will attach a short workback plan and two attachment stubs below.

Deliverables (initial):
- privileged-accounts-stub.xlsx (redacted)
- scim-delta-sample.csv
- workback-plan-hel-health.pdf (timeline and responsibilities)

If that works, I’ll loop in the infra team to pull the SCIM deltas and ask Naomi to run the role-activity query.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Security Lead, Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-1204

[Attachment stubs: privileged-accounts-stub.xlsx (xlsx), scim-delta-sample.csv (text/csv), workback-plan-hel-health.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: naomi_feldman@redwood.com
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@heliumhealth.com>
Date: 2028-07-22T13:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG request — sampling for privileged accounts and SCIM delta

Jonas — I’ll run the SCIM delta export tomorrow morning against the tenant snapshot. Quick notes for the export process (so the auditors have the right columns):
- Columns: event_id, timestamp (ISO8601), actor_user_id, actor_type (user/service), change_type (add/remove/modify), attribute_name, old_value, new_value, source_ip, request_id
- We’ll filter out purely cosmetic changes (display_name updates) and focus on role/entitlement changes to keep the CSV manageable.
- I’ll include a short README row in the CSV explaining redaction and hashing approach.

I’ll upload to the shared Drive folder and ping the link here when ready. Naomi

Naomi Feldman
Customer Security Manager, Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.com

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: naomi_feldman@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@heliumhealth.com>
Date: 2028-07-23T10:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG request — sampling for privileged accounts and SCIM delta

Looping in schedule: Naomi — can you confirm the exact query and estimated runtime? If the delta spans 90 days with audit logs and SCIM events we may need a short maintenance window for the export on prod. Proposed window: Friday 2028-07-26 02:00–04:00 PDT (low traffic).

Also will prepare the sampling selection script and produce the privileged-accounts-stub.xlsx with the redaction hash mapping stored in a separate secure doc. ETA for XSLX: Friday 2028-07-26 12:00 PDT.

Marissa Cole
Technical Program Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

From: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@heliumhealth.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: naomi_feldman@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, audit-team@heliumhealth.com
Date: 2028-07-25T15:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG request — sampling for privileged accounts and SCIM delta

Thanks team — that timeline looks good and the maintenance window is fine with us. A couple of quick asks from the auditors: please include in the workback-plan (1) the exact query text used to select the sample, (2) confirmation that role names are consistent across tenants or a map if not, and (3) whether service principals are included/excluded. If you can provide the artifacts to the Drive link in your note and then share a view-only link to audit-team@heliumhealth.com, we’ll pick up from there.

We’ll expect the initial CSV/XLSX by Friday midday (2028-07-26). If anything slips, please flag by EOD Thursday.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Alicia
Security Manager, HeliumHealth
